name: Murgaxor's orb
description: A dangerous glass relic that let Murgaxor control Augusta's mind.

description_citations.text: "Augusta Tullus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Augusta falls under Murgaxor Grenshel's control through his orb and withdraws into the Deans' Repository, spreading its curse by touch.
timeline.quote: the orb served as a conduit for the long-banished mage Murgaxor Grenshel

citation.text: "Augusta Tullus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Augusta is incapacitated and freed when the orb is destroyed, and works quietly to contain the matter.
timeline.quote: freeing her from Murgaxor's control when the orb was destroyed
